title: MarsWalk Saved Experiment Record
description: Persistent, immutable scientific simulation run preserving baseline route, disruption evaluations, and reproducibility metadata.

experiment_id.description: Unique, URL-safe identifier for the experiment record.

name.description: Human-readable designation of the simulation study.

mission_id.description: Associated mission record ID, if linked.

status.description: Engineering computation status of the primary baseline or scenario.

lifecycle_state.description: Scientific reproducibility status relative to current calculation environment.

baseline_fingerprint.description: Input fingerprint of the baseline traverse when simulation was performed.

mission_snapshot.description: Authoritative mission snapshot captured at calculation time.

baseline_route.description: Canonical baseline RouteResult with geometry, metrics, and timeline.

scenarios_evaluated.description: Individual disruption scenarios evaluated against baseline.

sensitivity_sweep.description: Parameter sensitivity sweep results, if performed.

recovery_plan.description: Recommended recovery route and trade-off plan, if computed.

replayed_from_experiment_id.description: Prior experiment ID if this record was generated by replaying a historical study.

reproducibility_notes.description: Explanatory notes regarding model assumptions or environment differences.
